coordinated_activities.activity: Working a night shift as an aged-care support worker at a residential care facility, assisting residents with personal care, repositioning and night checks, and writing up detailed handover notes
Travelling home from the night shift by train and bus, listening to nothing to keep calm and messaging ahead by text to confirm the plan for the day
Showering and changing out of work clothes after the night shift, putting the uniform straight into the washing machine
Making a light post-shift breakfast with tea and eating quietly at the bench
Sleeping after the night shift with the fan running for white noise and the light off, keeping the room quiet and dark
Waking up, boiling the kettle and having a late lunch of leftovers with a cup of tea
Moving the washed uniform to the clothes dryer and hand-washing smaller items, tidying the laundry area and using the dehumidifier
Washing the dishes, wiping the benches and checking the fridge, freezer and pantry against a written shopping list
Walking to the supermarket and doing the weekly grocery shop, comparing unit prices and paying in cash to stay within the weekly budget
Cooking a flexitarian dinner with the rice cooker and induction cooker and eating it at the table
Washing up, loading the dishwasher and putting the groceries away with labels on shared items
Studying Master of Social Work coursework at the desk with the desk lamp on, reading set texts on the monitor and typing notes on the computer
Taking a short break with a cup of tea and a light snack while re-reading the written task list for the week
Sending text messages to family in China, looking at the photo of the family dog, recording spending in the budget sheet and setting reminders for the next shift and class
Completing the evening wash routine and preparing clothes and bag for the next day
Sleeping with the light off and the fan on low for quiet background noise
